name: feeding-pedagogy
description: The pedagogy of feeding — how to talk about food with children, what the Division of Responsibility model says, age-appropriate autonomy in eating, how to handle picky eating without creating disordered eating, and how to teach nutrition concepts to learners at different levels without either moralizing or oversimplifying. Use when a question is about raising, teaching, or advising a child or learner on eating, or when planning curriculum or parent guidance.
